# CLI reference

<!-- Generated by `go run ./cmd/aitk __reference > docs/reference/cli.md`. Do not edit. -->

Global flags: `--json` prints one `aitk.result/v1` object; `-C, --path <dir>` runs as if started in `<dir>`.
Exit codes: 0 success · 1 runtime failure · 2 usage error · 3 gate rejected · 4 conflict.

## `aitk adapters doctor`

Report which tools are installed and whether their adapters are current

```
aitk adapters doctor [flags]
```

```
      --global   include user-level config
```

## `aitk adapters sync`

Install or update adapters for detected tools (idempotent)

```
aitk adapters sync [flags]
```

```
      --dry-run            show what would change
      --global             also edit user-level config (e.g. ~/.codex/config.toml); backed up first
      --tool stringArray   only this tool (repeatable): claude-code, codex, opencode, gemini-cli, kiro, cursor
```

## `aitk adr list`

List ADRs

```
aitk adr list
```

## `aitk adr new`

Create the next ADR

```
aitk adr new "<title>"
```

## `aitk brief`

Print the bounded session brief: start every session here

```
aitk brief [flags]
```

```
      --budget int    token budget (default: brief.budget or 4000)
      --task string   brief for this task instead of the active one
```

## `aitk check`

Run the project's check command and record evidence on the active task

```
aitk check
```

## `aitk ci`

Run every gate non-interactively (schemas, secrets, commit messages) for CI

```
aitk ci [flags]
```

```
      --base string   compare against this ref (default: PR base from CI env, else merge base with the default branch)
```

## `aitk close`

Finish the session: apply the Definition of Done, write evidence, handoff, and knowledge

```
aitk close [flags]
```

```
      --knowledge string   lasting finding, or "none" (required)
      --next stringArray   next step for whoever continues (repeatable)
      --status string      hand over unfinished work: in_progress or blocked (skips the Definition of Done)
      --summary string     what changed (required)
      --tag stringArray    tag for the knowledge entry (repeatable)
```

## `aitk deploy`

Run a deploy target from aitk.toml, then deploy.post_check

```
aitk deploy [target]
```

## `aitk doctor`

Validate the project; --fix repairs what is safe

```
aitk doctor [flags]
```

```
      --fix   repair generated files, the AGENTS.md block, and an overfull inbox
```

## `aitk hooks install`

Add aitk to the git hooks (existing hooks are kept)

```
aitk hooks install
```

## `aitk hooks uninstall`

Remove aitk from the git hooks

```
aitk hooks uninstall
```

## `aitk import github-issues`

Import issues as tasks (GH-<number>) via the gh CLI

```
aitk import github-issues [flags]
```

```
      --dry-run        show what would be imported
      --label string   only issues with this label
      --limit int      max issues (default 100)
      --repo string    owner/name (default: this repository)
      --state string   open, closed, or all (default "open")
```

## `aitk import openspec`

Import a openspec tasks checklist (default: discovered tasks.md files)

```
aitk import openspec [tasks.md ...] [flags]
```

```
      --dry-run   show what would be imported
```

## `aitk import spec-kit`

Import a spec-kit tasks checklist (default: discovered tasks.md files)

```
aitk import spec-kit [tasks.md ...] [flags]
```

```
      --dry-run   show what would be imported
```

## `aitk init`

Create aitk.toml, the AGENTS.md block, ai-state.json, and docs/ai/ (idempotent)

```
aitk init [flags]
```

```
      --check string   check command, e.g. "make test" (default: detected)
      --dry-run        show what would be created
      --name string    project name (default: directory name)
```

## `aitk knowledge add`

Add an entry to the inbox

```
aitk knowledge add "<text>" [flags]
```

```
      --pin               always show in briefs
      --tag stringArray   tag (repeatable); the first tag is the topic
```

## `aitk knowledge compact`

File inbox entries by topic, merge duplicates, archive old entries

```
aitk knowledge compact [flags]
```

```
      --dry-run   report only
```

## `aitk knowledge pin`

Pin entries containing the text

```
aitk knowledge pin "<text match>"
```

## `aitk knowledge search`

Ranked search

```
aitk knowledge search "<query>" [flags]
```

```
      --limit int   max results (default 10)
```

## `aitk log`

Handoffs, newest first: who (which tool) did what

```
aitk log [flags]
```

```
      --limit int     max entries (default 20)
      --task string   only this task
```

## `aitk mcp`

Serve aitk over the Model Context Protocol (stdio by default)

```
aitk mcp [flags]
```

```
      --http string   serve streamable HTTP on this address (e.g. 127.0.0.1:8770) instead of stdio
```

## `aitk migrate`

Convert a v1 ai-toolkit project to v2 (lossless; originals kept in docs/ai/_legacy/)

```
aitk migrate [flags]
```

```
      --dry-run   write nothing; print the report
```

## `aitk plugin list`

List discovered plugins, their hooks, and whether they are enabled

```
aitk plugin list
```

## `aitk report`

What was done, what is in progress or blocked, and which tools did it

```
aitk report [flags]
```

```
      --format string   md or json (json is also --json) (default "md")
      --since string    period: e.g. 24h, 7d, 30d, or a date (2026-10-01) (default "7d")
```

## `aitk review pass`

Record one review pass on the active task

```
aitk review pass [flags]
```

```
      --findings int   number of problems found in this pass (required) (default -1)
```

## `aitk switch`

Hand the work to another AI tool: write a handoff and start it with the brief

```
aitk switch <tool> [flags]
```

```
      --note string   why you are switching / what the next tool should know
      --print         print how to start the tool instead of starting it
```

## `aitk task block`

Mark a task blocked with a reason

```
aitk task block <id> [flags]
```

```
      --reason string   why it is blocked (required)
```

## `aitk task claim`

Claim a task for this worktree so other agents skip it

```
aitk task claim <id> [flags]
```

```
      --ttl duration   how long the claim lasts (default 4h0m0s)
```

## `aitk task list`

List tasks (open ones by default)

```
aitk task list [flags]
```

```
      --all             include done and cancelled
      --status string   only this status
```

## `aitk task new`

Create a task (status todo)

```
aitk task new "<title>" [flags]
```

```
      --ac stringArray     acceptance criterion, e.g. "Given …, when …, then …" (repeatable)
      --goal string        goal id (G-…)
      --id string          custom task id (default: random T-xxxx)
      --objective string   one-paragraph objective
      --profile string     pin the risk profile: lite, standard, strict
      --start              start the task immediately
      --tag stringArray    tag (repeatable)
```

## `aitk task release`

Drop this worktree's claim on a task

```
aitk task release <id> [flags]
```

```
      --force   drop any worktree's claim (use when that worktree is gone)
```

## `aitk task show`

Print one task

```
aitk task show <id>
```

## `aitk task start`

Make a task active in this worktree (status in_progress)

```
aitk task start <id>
```

## `aitk task update`

Edit structured task fields (default: the active task)

```
aitk task update [id] [flags]
```

```
      --ac-done string       mark criteria done, e.g. 1 or 1,3
      --add-ac stringArray   add a criterion (repeatable)
      --note string          append a timestamped note
      --profile string       pin the risk profile
      --status string        new status: todo, in_progress, implemented, in_review, done, blocked, cancelled
      --tag stringArray      add a tag (repeatable)
```

## `aitk version`

Print version information

```
aitk version
```

## `aitk work`

Create a dedicated worktree and branch for a task, claim it, and start it there

```
aitk work <id>
```
